title.zh: 地理标志（边境执法措施）规则 2022
title.vi: Quy tắc Chỉ dẫn địa lý (Biện pháp thực thi tại biên giới) 2022
title.th: กฎสิ่งบ่งชี้ทางภูมิศาสตร์ (มาตรการบังคับใช้ตามแนวชายแดน) 2022

completenessNote: 全文，共 16 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Rules are the Geographical Indications (Border Enforcement Measures) Rules 2022 and come into operation on 21 November 2022.

chapter.en: PART 2 SEIZURE OF GOODS ON REQUEST
PART 2 SEIZURE OF GOODS ON REQUEST

heading.en: Time and manner of giving notice under section 56(1) of Act

text.en:
3. A notice to the Director-General under section 56(1) of the Act must be delivered to the Singapore Customs —
(a)at any time that the office of the Singapore Customs is open for business; and
(b)at any time that is reasonably possible for an authorised officer to take any action under the Act in relation to the notice.

chapter.en: PART 2 SEIZURE OF GOODS ON REQUEST

heading.en: Further information and evidence for notice under section 56(1) of Act

text.en: 4. A person who has given a notice under section 56(1) of the Act to the Director‑General must, as and when required by the Director‑General, give to the Director‑General any information and evidence within the time and in the form that the Director‑General may reasonably require.

chapter.en: PART 2 SEIZURE OF GOODS ON REQUEST

heading.en: Change in particulars of notice under section 56(1) of Act

text.en: 5. A person who has given a notice to the Director‑General under section 56(1) of the Act must notify the Director‑General in writing of any change in the particulars specified in the notice or affecting the notice within 7 days of the change, and provide any documents and information in relation to the change that the Director‑General may reasonably require.

chapter.en: PART 2 SEIZURE OF GOODS ON REQUEST

heading.en: Refusal to seize goods pursuant to notice under section 56(1) of Act

text.en:
6. An authorised officer may refuse to seize any goods to which a notice under section 56(1) of the Act relates if the person who has given the notice fails to comply with —
(a)any direction of the Director-General; or
(b)any provision of these Rules.

chapter.en: PART 2 SEIZURE OF GOODS ON REQUEST

heading.en: Period under section 59(2)(a) of Act for instituting infringement action

text.en: 7. For the purposes of section 59(2)(a) of the Act, the prescribed period is 10 working days after the day specified in the notice mentioned in section 59(1) of the Act.

chapter.en: PART 2 SEIZURE OF GOODS ON REQUEST

heading.en: Period under section 59(6) of Act for extension of initial period

text.en: 8. For the purposes of section 59(6) of the Act, the prescribed period is 10 working days after the end of the initial period mentioned in that provision.
9. For the purposes of section 67A(1) of the Act, the prescribed period is 48 hours after the date of the written notice mentioned in section 67(2) of the Act.

heading.en: Time and manner of giving notice under section 67A(1) of Act

text.en: 11. A notice to the Director-General under section 67A(1) of the Act must be delivered to the Singapore Customs at any time that the office of the Singapore Customs is open for business.

heading.en: Further information and evidence for notice under section 67A(1) of Act

text.en: 12. A person who has given a notice under section 67A(1) of the Act to the Director‑General must, as and when required by the Director‑General, give to the Director‑General any information and evidence within the time and in the form that the Director‑General may reasonably require.

heading.en: Change in particulars of notice under section 67A(1) of Act

text.en: 13. A person who has given a notice to the Director‑General under section 67A(1) of the Act must notify the Director‑General in writing of any change in the particulars specified in the notice or affecting the notice within 7 days of the change, and provide any documents and information in relation to the change that the Director‑General may reasonably require.

heading.en: Release of seized goods to dealer under section 67A of Act

text.en:
14.—(1) The Director-General may release the seized goods in relation to which a notice has been given under section 67A(1) of the Act to the dealer concerned, if the person who gave the notice fails to comply with —
(a)any direction of the Director-General; or
(b)any provision of these Rules.
(2) In this rule, “dealer” means the importer or exporter of goods that are seized under section 67(1) of the Act.

heading.en: Period under section 67B(1)(a) of Act for instituting infringement action

text.en: 15. For the purposes of section 67B(1)(a) of the Act, the prescribed period is 10 working days after the day specified in the notice mentioned in section 67B(1) of the Act.

heading.en: Period for extension of initial period under section 59(6) of Act as applied by section 67B(2) of Act

text.en: 16. For the purposes of section 59(6) of the Act as applied by section 67B(2) of the Act, the prescribed period is 10 working days after the end of the initial period mentioned in section 59(6) of the Act.
